reviewSamples.author: G.
reviewSamples.text: Felix was prompt and professional and his prices are reasonable, highly recommend.

reviewSamples.author: Darlene Pillsbury
reviewSamples.text: Felix painted the entire outside of my house and did a great job. I get many compliments. He fixes anything inside of my house as well. He is very prompt and reliable. I highly recommend him for any job.

reviewSamples.author: Rose Maldonado
reviewSamples.text: Very professional. I highly recommend. The technician came out and diagnosed the issue and explained in detail why we were having the issue. I would highly recommend this company. Definitely a five star company.

reviewSamples.author: Zina Garcia
reviewSamples.text: Good customer service, arrived on time, great communication, easy to work with and gets the job done. Also a bonus that he speaks Spanish, I would recommend any day.

reviewSamples.author: Kim Dinapoli
reviewSamples.text: Excellent service at a fair and reasonable price. Felix was professional and detail oriented. Very pleased with all his work.
